musical_definition.scope_note: Broad New Age baseline; rhythmic/progressive/neo-classical subprofiles may override.
musical_definition.groove_behavior: low-to-moderate rhythmic aggression; pulse may be flowing, sparse, arpeggiated or absent
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: longer melodic arcs, breath/release space, gradual entrances and exits
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: spacious tonal/modal harmony; add9/maj7/sus/open voicings common as options, not requirements
musical_definition.bass_behavior: structural support with long tones, gentle motion or pedal behavior; avoid rigid repeated two-hit templates
musical_definition.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: optional light percussion; when present favor supportive texture over dominant backbeat unless subtype says otherwise
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: piano/electric piano/synth, flute, guitar, harp, strings, choir/textures as target resources; role separation foreground vs depth
musical_definition.ensemble_player_behavior: continuous expressive shaping and low masking between melody and pads/textures
musical_definition.arrangement_transformation: slow evolution of texture, register, orchestration and space; silence is valid material
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: legato and sustained articulation favored, with soft attacks where the selected instrument supports them
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: phrase-level microtiming and tempo breathing; repetition must evolve
musical_definition.continuous_performance_control: continuous expression, pedal, attack/release and ambience controls when target supports them
musical_definition.sound_effects_intent: reverb/depth intentional; avoid washing out foreground definition
musical_definition.mix_prominence_intent: clear foreground/background depth with broad spatial field
musical_definition.production_mastering_intent: smooth, open, low-harshness master; transient restraint unless subtype requires more activity
musical_definition.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: prefer expressive target voices; preserve continuous controller curves and long releases
provenance: AllMusic New Age reference already recorded in project

New Age.musical_development_policy: Build this genre's melody, harmony, bass, percussion, rhythm, form and expressive behaviors from its own definition and original sample links; no shared melody copying, no source edits, no blended stems.

musical_definition.scope_note: Project-defined nonsectarian baseline so the menu can function without silently mapping Spiritual to Gospel, Christian, New Age, meditation, or any Indigenous/religious tradition.
musical_definition.groove_behavior: gentle or moderate pulse chosen per composition; no tradition-specific sacred rhythm is assumed
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: reflective long phrases, silence and call-response may be used without borrowing a specific religious practice
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: tonal/modal/open harmony; no religious/cultural scale system is inferred automatically
musical_definition.bass_behavior: simple sustained or melodic support; no culturally specific bass pattern assumed
musical_definition.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: optional light percussion only; no ritual/tradition-specific drum pattern without explicit sourced subprofile
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: piano/guitar/strings/flute/choir-like or ambient target colors may be used as neutral project instrumentation, not as claims of religious tradition
musical_definition.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble supports contemplation and space; cultural signifiers require explicit subprofile
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: legato/sustained articulation favored; stronger rhythm only if explicitly requested
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: phrase breathing and shared rubato; no stereotyped sacred timing
musical_definition.sound_effects_intent: warm room/reverb may support spaciousness without implying ritual acoustics
musical_definition.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: neutral target voices only unless a culturally/religiously specific verified profile is chosen

Spiritual.musical_development_policy: Build this genre's melody, harmony, bass, percussion, rhythm, form and expressive behaviors from its own definition and original sample links; no shared melody copying, no source edits, no blended stems.
